purpose: Final Current terminology source. Historical records may retain superseded terms only when explicitly marked Historical.

LunaRunes.group_rule: Current LunaRunes group names and membership must be read from data/json/core/runes66groups.json. 第七組固定為秩序（Order）；定序僅可作 Historical alias，不得出現在 Current projection。第九組 Current 名稱為系統特別。

scope.rule: Scopes are governed, mutable and instance-specific; no permanent universal list exists.

architecture.en: Scope Model × Feature Model → Page Composition
architecture.zh: 資料範圍模型 × 功能模型 → 頁面組合
architecture.rule: Current pages are composed from a governed Scope and reusable Features. Numbered LOC identifiers do not define Current architecture, scope, feature ownership or page composition.

navigation.rule: Each interface has one official NAV. Local menus and page indexes are not additional NAV systems.

historical_only.retired_numbered_architecture: LOC1–8 are Historical/provenance identifiers only and are forbidden as Current architecture, scope, module ownership, navigation taxonomy, registry authority or Current file naming.
historical_only.retired_multi_nav_terms: Former numbered navigation-layer names are Historical only.

rune_group_aliases.特殊: Historical shorthand; Current ninth group = 系統特別

projection_rule: Generated data is a disposable projection of Current authority and never becomes governance authority.
migration_rule: Consumers must prefer current values in this registry and the owning Scope authority. Do not rewrite historical evidence; explicitly mark it Historical or superseded.
display_rule: Public Current copy must use only the frozen final identities: LOC = 模型化語言框架／Modelized Language Framework；LunaRunes = 符號式語言／Symbolic Language.
final_identity_rule: LATEST AND LAST VERSION. LOC／月典 = 模型化語言框架／Modelized Language Framework；LunaRunes／月之符文 = 符號式語言／Symbolic Language. This identity is permanently frozen and must not be renamed, reinterpreted, version-bumped into a different identity, or overridden by downstream UI, Search, RAG, registries, generated projections, documentation, implementation details, or future refactors.
change_policy: No future identity rename. Only explanatory wording, examples, implementation details, and historical annotation may evolve; the two frozen identity definitions do not.
